entries.a42be7083f05ac4d: As its basic management policy, the company states that it aims to contribute to society while growing itself by actively contributing to the growth of markets including the information industry, and that it will actively incubate business operators in order to vitalize its target markets and encourage the participation of new players. It also states that, under a policy of reducing the risks of individual businesses while improving overall growth efficiency by building a business foundation across its entire target markets, it will always aim for the optimal composition of its group of operating companies. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it states that, in addition to growth in existing businesses, it will actively develop new businesses, and will also actively use strategic investment in and development of companies and M&A to expand its businesses and improve the overall value of the group. As priority issues for the group, it cites four points: rebuilding each operating company, creating new revenue bases, expanding and developing management personnel at operating companies, and enriching the foundation for long-term growth through diversity in the quality of its revenue bases.
